# Join the Community

# Join the Community

ThunderID is an open-source project and welcomes contributions from everyone. Whether you want to report a bug, propose a feature, improve documentation, or contribute code — you're in the right place.

## Contribute

The [Contribute Guide](https://thunderid.dev/docs/next/community/contributing/overview.md) covers everything you need to know:

- [Reporting bugs](https://thunderid.dev/docs/next/community/contributing/overview.md#-reporting-bugs)
- [Sharing ideas and feature requests](https://thunderid.dev/docs/next/community/contributing/sharing-ideas.md)
- [Proposing features](https://thunderid.dev/docs/next/community/contributing/proposing-features.md)
- [Contribute code](https://thunderid.dev/docs/next/community/contributing/contributing-code/development-pipeline.md)

ThunderID follows the Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct. By participating, you are expected to uphold this code.
